newsitem.title: DUBAI: Emirates airline to start flights to Dar es Salaam.
newsitem.headline: Emirates airline to start flights to Dar es Salaam.

text.p: Emirates airline said it would start twice-weekly flights to Dar es Salaam on October 28.
It said in a statement the Tuesday and Thursday flights on Airbus A310-300 aircraft would be via Nairobi.
The route on Tuesdays is Dubai-Nairobi-Dar es Salaam-Dubai. On Thursdays the route is Dubai-Dar es Salaam-Nairobi-Dubai.
"The new destination offers good potential for Emirates' cargo operations with major exports (from Tanzania) comprising agricultural produce, cotton, tobacco and gemstones," Emirates said.
Imports into Dar es Salaam could include machinery, transport equipment, cotton goods and food.
Cargo capacity on the A310 is 10 to 12 tonnes.
The flights are subject to Tanzanian government approval. - Dubai newsroom +9714-626990
